description: This file defines the PersistableProduct class, a Java entity used in the sales manager web project. It extends ProductEntity and implements Serializable, encapsulating product details such as descriptions, images, categories, related products, manufacturer, and attributes.

classes.name: PersistableProduct
classes.description: Java class representing a persistable product entity with descriptions, attributes, images, categories, related products, and manufacturer information.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of product descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of product descriptions.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns the list of product images.

methods.name: setImages
methods.description: Sets the list of product images.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns the list of categories associated with the product.

methods.name: setCategories
methods.description: Sets the list of categories associated with the product.

methods.name: getRelatedProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of related products.

methods.name: setRelatedProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of related products.

methods.name: getManufacturer
methods.description: Returns the manufacturer of the product.

methods.name: setManufacturer
methods.description: Sets the manufacturer of the product.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the list of product attributes.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the list of product attributes.
